articles.summary: Banco Santander is the sole Founding Partner of Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix (GP). The event will take place in Madrid and boast exclusive activities hosted by the bank.
articles.title: Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix accelerates growth of Madrid’s economy

articles.summary: Santander AI Lab introduces A2K, an open specification that helps AI agents discover, query, cite and audit governed enterprise knowledge with scoped authority and traceability.
articles.title: A2K: a new protocol suite for connecting AI agents to governed, auditable enterprise knowledge

articles.summary: According to the European Central Bank, Spaniards currently have access to some of the cheapest mortgages in Europe. Economist José Carlos Díez, Professor of Economics at the University of Alcalá, analyses the key factors behind this and explains why today’s mortgage market is more resilient and competitive than it was in 2007.
articles.title: Why Does Spain Have the Cheapest Mortgages in Europe?

articles.summary: For younger generations, there’s no real divide between life and digital life. That’s why Santander has created a space dedicated to security, where kids, teens and the adults around them can learn to build stronger digital habits.
articles.title: Kids and teens at the centre of our new online security space

articles.summary: His Majesty the King today inaugurated Faro Santander, the museum launched by the Banco Santander Foundation at the bank’s historic headquarters on Paseo de Pereda, in the Cantabrian capital. The ceremony was attended by the Chair of Banco Santander, Ana Botín, as well as representatives from local institutions and the wider community.
articles.title: His Majesty The King officially opens Faro Santander with Ana Botín, Chair of Banco Santander, at the Bank’s former headquarters in the Cantabrian capital

articles.summary: Chile is one of Banco Santander’s strongest markets, where it’s been a leading bank for decades and the highest rated over the past five years.
articles.title: Chile turns its strengths -stability and growth- into new investment opportunities
